text.content: Test whether exact-zero-masked object-delta cross-attention and FiLM at all four action layers provides enough depth for dynamic-exclusive memory to affect denoising, while retaining the same final gate/residual and eliminating every absolute-memory main-policy bypass.

Eight-B200 training completes 500 finite optimizer steps and saves a complete 8-rank checkpoint; absolute-memory main context and conditioned RMS remain exactly zero; four delta-conditioned layers are active for aligned history and all new paths are exactly zero under zero intervention; slot cosine is below 0.95 and both contrastive margins exceed 0.05; aligned main action loss is at least 1% lower than both zero and shuffle on the matched 2048-sample validation. No 20k unless every gate passes.

R4 model-only warm start; train complete strong_action_expert; absolute visual-memory main context and conditioners disabled; exact-zero-masked object-delta cross-attention plus FiLM at all 4 action layers; same final delta gate/residual as R6-A; 500 steps; batch 64/rank; DP8; matched validation.
RoboCasa365 B4 processed split plus 1,143,698-record triple-view Wan latent cache and episode-safe t-36/t-24/t-12 visual-history sidecar; same data and held-out stream as R6-A; no future lookup.
wam@208.64.254.190; pyrogpucompute1; cwam-b4-runtime:ngc25.09-ffmpeg6; /data0/wam/cwam-b4/env/cosmos-cu130; offline model assets.
pyrogpucompute1; 8 x NVIDIA B200 183359 MiB; batch 64 per rank; effective global batch 512.

Aligned/zero/shuffle main action losses and gains; main context token count; delta-conditioned layer count/RMS; applied delta RMS and ratio; slot cosine; contrastive margins; action-gradient validity; step time; GPU memory/utilization/power.

R6-B differs from R6-A only by exposing the same object-local delta tokens through cross-attention and FiLM after each of four action layers. Exact masking makes every added update identically zero when no valid temporal delta exists, preserving a clean none/zero/shuffle intervention.
